title: TeleNeo Font Family
slide_intent: Separate font availability from permission to use it so teams obtain the correct tools for consistent work.
strategic_value: A clear access route can reduce substitute fonts and inconsistent T-Mobile typography.
demonstration: Licensing text at left and installation guidance at upper right sit above an oversized cropped TeleNeo specimen.
practical_value: Identify the correct employee or external-partner access route before installing or sharing the font.

content_islands.spec: Place the font-family title and distribution rules at left.

content_islands.name: Access instructions
content_islands.spec: List family size, Office access and partner registration in the upper-right text block.

content_islands.name: Typeface signature
content_islands.spec: Crop an oversized magenta TeleNeo word along the lower edge.
